title: The Taxpayer Development Journey: Code
description: Code of the project The Taxpayer Development Journey: A Behavioral Lifecycle Architecture for Tax Compliance: Evidence from Tanzania: the pipeline that regenerates every model output from survey and published data (run_all.py, src/), the scripted figures, the tests and the Streamlit dashboard. Every number is labelled COMPUTED, MODELLED, CITED or ILLUSTRATIVE. The raw survey data are not included. Companion records: the report (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24387574) and the aggregate data (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24387022).
